messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- As of 2025-11-27, Yuki Tanaka holds the Cinder pager, taking over from Diego, who is leaving the team. [valid 2025-11-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-27]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-24, Diego holds the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka. [valid 2025-10-24 to 2025-11-27; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-24]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team owns the bus, having taken it over from the Boreal team. [valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-15, the Boreal team still owns the bus. [valid 2025-08-15 to 2025-11-24; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-15-2]
- On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team flagged the job scheduler's cold start regression because the job scheduler is not their service. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2]
- On 2025-06-25 Oskar walked Farah through the job scheduler runbook. [valid 2025-06-25 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-scheduler]
- As of 2025-04-29, the job scheduler still relies on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-29]
- During incident INC-2026-009, the job scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service for per-job kill switches. [valid 2025-02-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-07]
- The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run. [valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-06]
- As of 2026-05-19, the job scheduler's leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings Cinder instead of the Dune team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- As of 2025-09-05, the Dune team still owned the job scheduler; ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-05, the Dune team still owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2]
- On 2025-06-06 the Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node. [decision; valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-06]
- On 2026-05-22 the Dune team reported that the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-3]
- The job scheduler was owned by the Dune team from 2025-06-25, having moved from the Ember team, until ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: The job scheduler is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-25, having moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-09-23; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-scheduler]
    earlier: The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the ledger service about the memory growth. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
- On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the authentication gateway about the error rate. [valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]

Question: Who owns the scheduler today?

message.reasoning:
The question asks who owns the scheduler today (2026-06-30).

Looking at the memory:
- As of 2025-09-23, ownership of the job scheduler transferred from Dune to Cinder. [valid 2025-09-23 to now]
- The job scheduler was owned by Dune from 2025-06-25 until ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23. [valid 2025-09-23 to now]

So today, Cinder owns the job scheduler.
